note: Both sets are heavily redundant, repeating the same starting-water minimum (96.00 oz / 2.721 kg) and Figure 9 vaporized-water thresholds several times, and both omit the body-text full-credit figure of 5.000 lb (80.00 oz / 2.268 kg) and the linear scaling of reduced points. Set B is more faithful in binding the scoring thresholds, preserving the inequality signs (≥80 oz, ≤16 oz, 16<Weight<80 oz, 450<Weight<2300 g) exactly as printed. Set A drops the inequalities in several threshold claims (stating bare values 16 oz, 80 oz, 2300 g, 450 g) and loosely renders the single-container requirement as 'vaporized in a single task', a mild misstatement. Otherwise the two sets cover essentially the same correct facts.
